facts.fact: Orzo 告诉 Reuben 又出现三具绿血尸体。
facts.anchor: Three more deaths have popped up.

facts.fact: 死者眼睛里涌出绿色血液。
facts.anchor: Green blood pooling out of their eyes.

facts.fact: Reuben 宣布找到杀手，将在自家餐厅包间见面。
facts.anchor: “I have found us a hitman. They are going to meet me at one of my restaurants.

facts.fact: 名单上有三个 Aldente，Reuben 决定最后再动他们。
facts.anchor: There are three Aldentes on the list. I think we should go after them last.

facts.fact: Reuben 想起 Orzo 一直被父亲折磨，直到父亲死去才解脱。
facts.anchor: That he had to be tortured by his father before escaping him only in his death.

facts.fact: Reuben 承认自己有一丁点感激那种毒杀死了 Herb。
facts.anchor: That a tiny small part of me is grateful for the poison in the drugs that killed Herb.

facts.fact: Orzo 问诅咒能不能转给别人。
facts.anchor: Orzo fixates over my shoulder as he speaks. “Do you think there’s a chance we can pass our curse along?”

facts.fact: Orzo 追问：如果我们在正路上、而命定之人不在呢？
facts.anchor: “I mean… What if we were on the correct path but the person we were supposed to be with wasn’t?”

facts.fact: Reuben 问他还好吗，他答不，摔门而去。
facts.anchor: Orzo meets my gaze. “No.” And then he flips around, whipping open the door and stomping out of the room.

facts.fact: Reuben 临时决定让 Colby 替他赴会。
facts.anchor: I made the decision at the last minute for Colby to take my place.

facts.fact: 他要求这件事查不到自己头上。
facts.anchor: I need this to not be traced back to me, it would be impossible to even determine my ownership of this restaurant.

facts.fact: 他以为 Cinnamon 是化名，从没见过这个人。
facts.anchor: I wasn’t even sure of their gender. Cinnamon seemed to be a pseudonym, it certainly wasn’t anyone I had crossed paths with in the past.

facts.fact: 走进包间的女人让他认定：这就是黑寡妇。
他得出结论：对付名单上这些人，她正是他要的人。
facts.anchor: For these men? She’s exactly who I need.
